purpose: Labels statuses, categories, and compact numeric counts.
useWhen: A compact status or category label is needed.
A notification-style count or status dot is needed.

avoidWhen.situation: Users need to click or toggle the label.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use an interactive control instead of making Badge behave like one.

avoidWhen.situation: A full contextual message is needed.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a message component with title and description.

approvedPatterns: Use semantic intent for status meaning.
Use counter mode for compact counts.
Provide an accessible label for a standalone status dot.
limitations: Status dots hide themselves from assistive technology unless labeled.
Leading icons are not shown in counter or dot modes.
accessibility: Do not rely on color alone to communicate status.
Add aria-label when a dot or context-free count needs an accessible meaning.
responsive: Labels truncate within the available inline width.
rtl: Leading content and logical positioning follow the surrounding direction.
